{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the P2P label and modifies connection polling in src/net.cpp and P2P functional tests.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Prevents busy loops in socket polling and avoids unrequested reads bypassing backpressure limits. As noted in commit a626b28980, select() can continuously report TCP urgent indications without consumable data, causing a busy loop in the polling loop, which this PR mitigates by disconnecting or ignoring exceptfds."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies HTTP server socket exception handling in src/httpserver.cpp and adds coverage in test/functional/interface_http.py.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Ensures HTTP server sockets on Windows immediately disconnect upon exceptional conditions rather than lingering in unexpected states. This aligns the HTTP server's socket error handling with best practices without changing API behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test framework changes in test_framework/netutil.py and test_framework.py exist strictly to test the socket error handling changes in P2P and HTTP.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Edits to netutil.py and test_runner.py are scaffolding for the area-specific tests p2p_socket_errors.py and interface_http.py rather than broader framework infrastructure improvements."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes socket polling abstractions in src/util/sock.cpp and src/util/sock.h.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes platform-specific socket polling behavior in the Sock abstraction. Commit 7cc5f0a901 notes that the select() backend only adds sockets to the exception set on Windows, preventing redundant no-op FD_ISSET checks and unhandled OOB data on other platforms."
    }
  ],
